## account.decks [#account.decks]

**My presentations.** The caller’s deck index with the owner and the caller’s role per row: owned, shared with me, recent, trash, or all for an admin; on a checkout every deck as owned.

| Field  | Type                                                | Required | Description |
| ------ | --------------------------------------------------- | -------- | ----------- |
| `view` | "owned" \| "shared" \| "recent" \| "trash" \| "all" | yes      |             |

- Command line: `turboslide account decks --view <view>`
- MCP tool: `deck_list_my_decks`
- HTTP: `POST /api/actions/account.decks`
- Runs on: command line, MCP, HTTP, page.
- Changes the presentation: no.

## account.tokens.create [#account.tokens.create]

**Create API key.** Mints an API key owned by the caller with a name, scopes and an optional expiry, shown once; never over MCP, and refused on a checkout, which has no accounts.

| Field       | Type                                                               | Required | Description |
| ----------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------ | -------- | ----------- |
| `name`      | string                                                             | yes      |             |
| `scopes`    | "read" \| "comment" \| "write" \| "export" \| "share" \| "admin"[] | yes      |             |
| `expiresAt` | string                                                             | no       |             |

- Command line: `turboslide account tokens create --to <to> --name <name> --scope <scopes> --expires <expiresAt>`
- MCP tool: No MCP tool.
- HTTP: `POST /api/actions/account.tokens.create`
- Runs on: command line, HTTP, page.
- Changes the presentation: yes.

## account.tokens.list [#account.tokens.list]

- Command line: `turboslide account tokens list --to <to>`

## account.tokens.revoke [#account.tokens.revoke]

**Revoke API key.** Revokes one of the caller’s keys; its MCP sessions close.

- Changes the presentation: yes.

## account.me [#account.me]

**Account.** The caller’s principal, trust state, label, mark, avatar choice and sessions; the CLI can write the mark as a PNG.

| Field       | Type   | Required | Description                               |
| ----------- | ------ | -------- | ----------------------------------------- |
| `avatarPng` | string | no       | CLI: write the mark as a PNG to this path |

- Command line: `turboslide account me --avatar-png <avatarPng>`
- MCP tool: `deck_get_me`
- HTTP: `POST /api/actions/account.me`
- Runs on: command line, MCP, HTTP, page.
- Changes the presentation: no.

## account.setName [#account.setName]

**Change name.** Sets the display name under the rules of SPEC-3 0.19 (NFC, 1 to 40 code points with a letter or digit, no bidi controls, the reserved and confusable lists, unique per deck by skeleton); the refusal sentences are fixed.

| Field  | Type   | Required | Description |
| ------ | ------ | -------- | ----------- |
| `name` | string | yes      |             |

- Command line: `turboslide account name <name>`
- MCP tool: `deck_set_my_name`
- HTTP: `POST /api/actions/account.setName`
- Runs on: command line, MCP, HTTP, page.
- Changes the presentation: yes.

## account.setAvatar [#account.setAvatar]

**Change avatar.** Chooses the mark: initials, a glyph field, a dither plate, or a picture for signed in principals only.

| Field      | Type                                           | Required | Description                                                                                    |
| ---------- | ---------------------------------------------- | -------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `variant`  | "initials" \| "glyph" \| "dither" \| "picture" | yes      |                                                                                                |
| `initials` | string                                         | no       |                                                                                                |
| `salt`     | integer                                        | no       | Another glyph or plate                                                                         |
| `picture`  | string                                         | no       | A data URL of a JPEG, PNG, WebP or GIF under 512 KB; sharp re-encodes it and keeps no original |

- Command line: `turboslide account avatar --variant <variant> --initials <initials> --another --picture <file>`
- MCP tool: `deck_set_my_avatar`
- HTTP: `POST /api/actions/account.setAvatar`
- Runs on: command line, MCP, HTTP, page.
- Changes the presentation: yes.

## account.signOut [#account.signOut]
